name: Flavor Finder: Swipe & Vote
subtitle: Swipe. Vote. Eat together.
promotionalText: Discover restaurants, save your favorites, and pick dinner together. Friends swipe the same deck, with a shared winner or another round to break a tie.
description:
Make choosing where to eat part of the fun.

Discover restaurants near you or in a city you choose. Filter by cuisine, budget, rating, distance and opening hours, then sort loaded results by rating, distance or price. Save places you want to try and explore available photos, reviews and restaurant details.

Eating with friends? Create a room, share its six-digit code or invitation, and swipe the same restaurant deck together. Flavor Finder counts the likes and shows everyone the same group pick. If the top choices tie, keep the random winner or let the host start another round with only the tied restaurants.

• Explore as a guest, or create an account to sync saved places and preferences.
• Use your location or search a city or ZIP code.
• Invite up to 10 people to vote on 2–20 restaurants.
• Keep individual votes private during voting and see group results afterward.
• Save favorites and open available restaurant contact, website and map links.

Flavor Finder includes advertising on Saved and completed group results. There are no paid memberships or in-app purchases in this version.

Restaurant information is provided by Google Maps. Hours, prices, availability and ratings can change; confirm important details with the restaurant. Internet access is required for restaurant discovery and group voting.
reviewNotes: Sign-in is not required. Restaurant discovery, local saved places and group voting work as a guest. Location permission is optional: tap Change and enter Columbus, Ohio to test without it. For group voting use two devices/sessions: in Eat Together enter nicknames; the host chooses an area and filters, finds and confirms restaurants, then creates a room. The other participant joins with the six-digit code before the host starts voting. Use swipes or Pass/Like. Everyone sees the same winner; the host can start a runoff between tied places. Rooms expire after 24 hours. Optional registered accounts sync favorites and preferences; Profile → Delete account uses password reauthentication. Build 19 uses Google AdMob live banner units on Saved and completed results, requests non-personalized ads, and gates requests through Google UMP. No ATT prompt or IDFA access is requested. Ads can be absent when consent or ad inventory is unavailable. There are no in-app purchases or paid memberships.
